stylePrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE full-bleed 9:16 portrait illustration for a premium Chinese poetry reader. Refined traditional Chinese ink with delicate translucent watercolor on warm ivory xuan paper, restrained celadon, soft ochre and ink grey, naturally textured brushwork, airy lyrical depth. Tang-era clothing, architecture and objects if relevant. CRITICAL COMPOSITION: main subjects are confined to the TOP 25–30% of the tall sheet, softly dissolving into ivory mist by 33% height. The central and lower 65% must be almost blank warm ivory writing paper for separately rendered poem text. No strong shapes below that area; tiny pale motifs at outermost bottom corners only if truly needed. All four paper edges are full bleed: no frame, rectangular picture boundary, green outer border, UI, collage, modern objects, written characters, title, calligraphy, stamp, seal, logo or watermark. Not a generic interchangeable landscape: use the exact poem's setting, season, emotional tone and main visual moment. Paint no words from the poem.

initialDirections.2: An elderly Tang poet with a thin grey beard and plain robe leaning on a wooden walking stick outside his humble damaged thatched cottage, wet straw torn from its roof and blown toward a few bamboo stems, late autumn gusts and a dark rain cloud. Show dignified concern and hardship without melodrama, no mansion or fantasy vision. The small cottage and poet are both high in the composition; descending rain dissolves into clean blank paper.
initialDirections.3: A frail elderly charcoal seller, soot-darkened fingers and grey temples, in thin patched clothes beside a tired ox and a wooden cart carrying charcoal sacks, resting outside an ancient city gate on a cold snowy morning. Small dull-red silk strip tied to the ox hints at unfair forced trade, but no written document or lettering. Muted winter grey and warm paper; poignant dignity, not a cheerful market scene.
initialDirections.4: A Tang musician seated playing an upright angular ancient konghou harp with taut strings in a quiet autumn setting; musical feeling suggested by pale clouds held still and a few glimmering droplets in the high background. Refined otherworldly poetic atmosphere but grounded instrument and musician, no modern concert harp or piano, no floating musical notes. One principal musician; do not collage all of the poem's mythical images.
initialDirections.5: A secluded woodland glade with lush fragrant orchid-like plants and ruocao, delicate reddish blossoms on purple-green stems, a few leaves beginning to fall in the first autumn breeze under low late sunlight. No human figures; express beauty flourishing unnoticed and the fragility of passing seasons. Botanical focal detail high on the paper.
initialDirections.6: Vast pale sandy desert at sunset, ONE narrow straight column of smoke rising from a distant frontier beacon, ONE round low sun beside a long smooth river, a tiny envoy carriage far off on the desert path. Majestic open horizontal space contained high on the portrait paper, muted sand and terracotta glow, no multiple suns or modern towers.
initialDirections.7: A Tang general in practical muted hunting attire on horseback after a winter hunt, bow lowered, a hunting hawk poised nearby, dried grasses and the last small patches of thawing snow on the plain. Flat evening clouds recede beyond distant encampment roofs. Composed energy, no gore, no dead animals or battle scene.
initialDirections.8: A spring-night river path in fine quiet rain, dark soft clouds and moist tree silhouettes framing a single warm lantern on a small moored riverboat. Very subtle wet budding branches at the bank. Poetic nourishing rain and a single golden light, not a thunderstorm; night rendered with translucent grey-green wash rather than a black full-page background.
initialDirections.9: A weary elderly Tang scholar on horseback halted on a snowbound mountain pass, with a younger male relative approaching beside the trail. Qinling peaks and a bank of clouds cut across the high background; snow partly blocks the narrow road. Somber dignified exile, all high in the painting.
initialDirections.10: A weathered abandoned wooden boat at the riverbank while several small white-sailed boats pass on open water beyond; an old bare tree at the edge with fresh green woodland behind. Evoke loss and renewal with calm spring light; no sinking people or disaster. One coherent riverside scene.
initialDirections.11: Early spring on West Lake: a lakeside white-sand path under light green willow branches, shallow new grass around the hooves of a small horse carrying a poet, orioles in budding trees and a pair of swallows collecting wet mud near the shore. Sparse low blossoms, newly risen water, low soft clouds. Fresh and quiet, not fully flowering summer.
initialDirections.12: View from an old high city tower as gusting wind moves reeds and willow branches; heavy clouds gather behind a pavilion hiding the sinking sun, abandoned palace grounds and a river stretch into evening haze. A few distant birds settle in wild grass. Historical melancholy, no lightning or violent storm.
initialDirections.13: At snowy dusk a tiny poor whitewashed mountain cottage with a rough wooden gate, a small dog at the entrance, a bundled traveler arriving along a snow-covered path, distant mountains fading into cold twilight. One faint warm light from the cottage, restrained winter watercolor.
initialDirections.14: A Tang-era farmer in plain coarse clothing bent over with a hoe tending young grain in a dry field at high noon, beads of effort suggested through posture, small modest terraced strips and warm summer haze. Dignified labor, no giant bowl of rice or modern machinery, no decorative celebration.
initialDirections.15: One graceful willow with fresh jade-green early-spring leaves and long slender hanging boughs, moved by a gentle breeze above a quiet riverbank. Fine ink stems, translucent young leaf tips, soft natural rhythm. No scissors, no figures or text; keep all willow ends within the upper third.
